shared_elements: human figures shown in strict profile
stylized curled/beaded hair and beard conventions
procession or repeated file of figures (A) vs single figure (B)
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in strict profile carved in low relief, with the same distinctive conventions of tightly ranked curls in beard and hair, an almond frontal-looking eye in a profile head, and elaborate headgear — a specific and conventional correspondence rather than a generic one. The biggest difference in content is scope: A shows an architectural panorama with columns, terraces, a long file of processional figures and a lion attacking a bull, while B isolates a single head-and-shoulders bust with no scene, setting or interaction.
